altar.name: Summoning Altar
altar.description: Offer a Slab depicting a Pal to summon a powerful Pal to your base. Adequate caution and battle readiness is paramount.

ancientblastfurnace.name: Ancient Furnace
ancientblastfurnace.description: A special furnace based on ancient technology that can smelt all types of ingots. Materials are melted with fire, then quickly cooled and solidified using ice. It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Cooling suitability.

ancientcookingstove.name: Ancient Kitchen
ancientcookingstove.description: A special kitchen based on ancient technology that can create everything from existing dishes to entirely new recipes. It retains heat through fire and completes cooking with manual preparation, allowing it to prepare any kind of cuisine. It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Handiwork suitability.

ancientelectricgenerator.name: Ancient Power Generator
ancientelectricgenerator.description: A highly efficient power generator restored from lost ancient technology. It produces massive amounts of electricity, but is prone to overheating while in operation. It requires Pals with high-level Generating Electricity and any level of Watering suitability.

ancientfarmblock.name: Ancient Farm
ancientfarmblock.description: A special cultivation device based on ancient technology that harnesses the power of the World Tree to grow all kinds of plants on Palpagos Island. Smaller than a berry plantation and suitable for indoor placement, it still follows the same cultivation process as standard plots. It requires Pals with high-level Planting, Watering, and Harvesting suitability.

ancientmultiproduct.name: Ancient Material Synthesizer
ancientmultiproduct.description: A special generator based on ancient technology that uses the power of the World Tree to produce all kinds of wood and ore. Due to its complex structure, only one Pal can be assigned to it.

ancientrelicrecycler.name: Ancient Relic Recycler
ancientrelicrecycler.description: An ancient civilization device that converts materials using repurposed technology from a lost civilization. It deciphers the technology left within Ancient Relics and refines them into new forms. A highly specialized facility designed for the efficient use of relics without waste.

ancientworkbench.name: Ancient Workbench
ancientworkbench.description: A Pal-exclusive workbench that is capable of crafting any item in one place. It cannot be used by the player, and operates at the same speed as a regular workbench. Due to its advanced equipment, it requires Pals with high-level Handiwork and Medicine Production suitability.

ancient_clinic.name: Ancient Clinic
ancient_clinic.description: A top-tier medical facility that reproduces advanced ancient medical technology. It offers significantly greater protective capability than a standard clinic. By assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability, even bases with harsh working conditions can maintain the highest level of hygiene.

ancient_diagonalwall.name: Ancient Diagonal Wall
ancient_diagonalwall.description: An angled wall built on triangular foundations to keep out intruders. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_doorwall.name: Ancient Wall and Door
ancient_doorwall.description: Door built on a foundation. Becomes an entrance.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_fence.name: Ancient Fence
ancient_fence.description: Fencing built on foundations and roofs for keeping out intruders.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_foundation.name: Ancient Foundation
ancient_foundation.description: A foundation for building walls or facilities.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_medicalpalbed.name: Ancient Pal Bed
ancient_medicalpalbed.description: An ultimate Pal Bed made from ancient recovery pod with soft matress. It offers one of the highest SAN recovery rates of all Pal beds, quickly relieving fatigue. It is the same size as a Large Pal Bed, allowing large Pals to rest comfortably.

ancient_pillars.name: Ancient Pillar
ancient_pillars.description: Column for structural support.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_pyramidroof.name: Ancient Pyramid Roof
ancient_pyramidroof.description: A pyramidal roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_roof.name: Ancient Roof
ancient_roof.description: A roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_slantedroof.name: Ancient Slanted Roof
ancient_slantedroof.description: Slanted roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_slopedroofcorner.name: Ancient Slanted Triangular Roof
ancient_slopedroofcorner.description: A slanted triangular roof built on top of diagonal walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_slopedroofcornerreverse.name: Ancient Slanted Triangular Roof (Inverted)
ancient_slopedroofcornerreverse.description: An inverted slanted triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_spa.name: Ancient Hot Spring
ancient_spa.description: A hot spring built with ancient technology, filled with special water infused with Paldium. It offers the highest SAN recovery of all hot springs and also restores Health. It is the same size as a standard hot spring, and can fully heal injured Pals.

ancient_stair.name: Ancient Stairs
ancient_stair.description: Stairs placed below a foundation or roof to climb up.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_trianglefoundation.name: Ancient Triangular Foundation
ancient_trianglefoundation.description: A triangular foundation for building walls or facilities. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_triangleroof.name: Ancient Triangular Roof
ancient_triangleroof.description: A triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_trianglestairscorner.name: Ancient Corner Roof
ancient_trianglestairscorner.description: A corner roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_trianglewall.name: Ancient Triangular Wall
ancient_trianglewall.description: Triangular wall built on a foundation to keep out intruders.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_trianglewallreverse.name: Ancient Triangular Wall (Inverted)
ancient_trianglewallreverse.description: An inverted triangular wall built on a foundation to keep out intruders. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_wall.name: Ancient Wall
ancient_wall.description: Walls built on foundations to keep out intruders.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_wallgate.name: Ancient Pal Passage Entrance
ancient_wallgate.description: An entrance to a Pal passage built on a foundation. Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

ancient_windowwall.name: Ancient Wall and Window
ancient_windowwall.description: Wall with windows, built on a foundation to keep out intruders.  Recreates the architectural style of ancient civilizations.

andon.name: Japanese Paper Lantern
andon.description: Decorative Paper Lantern. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

arcadevideogame.name: Arcade Game Cabinet
arcadevideogame.description: Decorative arcade machine. Broken, it can't be played.

basecampbattledirector.name: Alarm Bell
basecampbattledirector.description: Bell that sets the alert status for Pals on base. Change Pal behavior to either attack invading enemies, or focus entirely on work whenever you like.

basecampitemdispenser.name: Item Retrieval Machine
basecampitemdispenser.description: A device that lets you freely access items from all chests in the base.

basecampworkerextrastation.name: Palbox Control Device
basecampworkerextrastation.description: A remote-access terminal for the Palbox.  Set it up wherever you'd like and build a base of your own design.

basecampworkhard.name: Monitoring Stand
basecampworkhard.description: Command your Pals to work on various things inside a base. You can allow or prohibit individual kinds of work.

basecampworkhard02.name: High Quality Monitoring Stand
basecampworkhard02.description: A refined monitoring station with improved materials and structure. In addition to being able to issue work orders, the system also lowers the SAN cost for Pals working at the base.  Working conditions are slightly improved, making Pals less likely to become dissatisfied.

basecampworkhard03.name: Ancient Monitoring Stand
basecampworkhard03.description: A monitoring station based on ancient technology, embedded with Red Paldium. It issues commands across the entire base through a holographic interface, reducing SAN depletion in Pals. A special wavelength surrounds the base, keeping Pals calm even in harsh working environments.

believer_banner.name: Free Pal Alliance Vertical Banner
believer_banner.description: Decorative Free Pal Alliance Vertical Banner.

blastfurnace.name: Primitive Furnace
blastfurnace.description: Allows refinement of Ingot. The quality leaves much to desire, and processing is slow. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

blastfurnace2.name: Improved Furnace
blastfurnace2.description: Allows refinement of Refined Ingot. The quality has improved, but the processing speed is still unsatisfactory. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

blastfurnace3.name: Electric Furnace
blastfurnace3.description: Allows refinement of Pal Metal Ingot. It requires electricity to use, but is quicker to process. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

blastfurnace4.name: Gigantic Furnace
blastfurnace4.description: Allows refinement of Hexolite. By growing in size, multiple Pals can collaborate to perform smelting. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

bonsai.name: Bonsai
bonsai.description: Decorative Bonsai. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

box02_iron.name: Cloth Covered Container
box02_iron.description: Cloth covered container for storing items.

breedfarm.name: Breeding Farm
breedfarm.description: Assign one male and one female Pal to produce eggs. Placing Cake in the facility is required for production.

buildablegoddessstatue.name: Statue of Power
buildablegoddessstatue.description: Stone statue spoken of in legends on Palpagos Island. Offer up Lifmunk Effigy to receive strange powers.

byobu.name: Folding Screen
byobu.description: Decorative folding screen. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.description: Needed for cooking food. It can only be used to grill simple ingredients. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

candlestand.name: Majestic Candlestick
candlestand.description: An imposing candlestick lit by the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre and revered as sacred.  It can be placed on the ground. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

cauldron.name: Witch Cauldron
cauldron.description: Place in base to improve medicine manufacturing speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

ceilinglamp.name: Ceiling Lamp
ceilinglamp.description: A light source that provides illumination to a base even at night. It can be placed on a ceiling. Requires electricity, but lights up a larger area.

characterrankup.name: Pal Essence Condenser
characterrankup.description: A chamber for increasing a Pal's rank. Pals can surpass their physical limitations if given a concentrated extract taken from a Pal of the same type.

clinic.name: Clinic
clinic.description: A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base. Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury. While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

clock01_stone.name: Antique Grandfather Clock
clock01_stone.description: Decorative antique grandfather clock. Broken, it doesn't tell time.

clock01_wall_iron.name: Wall Clock
clock01_wall_iron.description: Decorative wall clock. Broken, it doesn't tell time.

coalpit.name: Coal Quarry
coalpit.description: Facility for producing Coal. Digging Coal is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

compositedesk.name: Drafting Table
compositedesk.description: A facility that lets you combine multiple schematics to create more advanced ones.

conservationgroupbannerb.name: Free Pal Alliance Horizontal Banner
conservationgroupbannerb.description: Decorative Free Pal Alliance horizontal banner.

container01_iron.name: Large Container
container01_iron.description: Large container for storing items. Imitates the designs left behind by an ancient and prosperous civilization.

cookingstove.name: Cooking Pot
cookingstove.description: Needed for cooking food. Use of a cooking pot allows for a wider variety of meal preparation. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

cooler.name: Cooler
cooler.description: A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base. It doesn't provide much relief from the heat, but helps one to endure somewhat hot environments. Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

coolerbox.name: Cooler Box
coolerbox.description: Small food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

coolerpalfoodbox.name: Cold Food Box
coolerpalfoodbox.description: A feeding box that can be kept cold. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

copperpit.name: Ore Mining Site
copperpit.description: Facility for producing Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

copperpit_2.name: Ore Mining Site II
copperpit_2.description: Facility for producing large quantities of Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

crusher.name: Crusher
crusher.description: Facility for breaking down Stone and Wood to exchange them for other materials. Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

crystalpit.name: Hexolite Quartz Mine
crystalpit.description: Facility for producing Hexolite Quartzs.  Digging Hexolite Quartzs is grueling physical work.  Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

curtain01_wall_stone.name: Antique Curtain
curtain01_wall_stone.description: Decorative antique curtain. Can be placed on walls.

damagedscarecrow.name: Training Dummy
damagedscarecrow.description: Training dummy shaped like a Pengullet. Can only be placed in wide open areas.

defensebowgun.name: Mounted Crossbow
defensebowgun.description: A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies. When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a crossbow.

defensemachinegun.name: Mounted Machine Gun
defensemachinegun.description: A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies. When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a machine gun.

defensemissile.name: Mounted Missile Launcher
defensemissile.description: A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies. When a Pal with Handiwork suitability is assigned, it will continuously defend the base using a missile launcher.

defensewait.name: Sandbag
defensewait.description: A defensive installation for protecting a base from enemies. When a Pal is assigned, it will stop other work and stay on lookout and prepare for combat.

defensewall.name: Stone Defensive Wall
defensewall.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

defensewall_metal.name: Metal Defensive Wall
defensewall_metal.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

defensewall_wood.name: Wooden Defensive Wall
defensewall_wood.description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from wood, it breaks easily.

dimensionpalstorage.name: Dimensional Pal Storage
dimensionpalstorage.description: A facility for storing a large number of captured Pals.  Any guild member can deposit or withdraw Pals. If you set it to private, it can serve as your personal Pal storage.

dismantlingconveyor.name: Pal Disassembly Conveyor
dismantlingconveyor.description: A dream-like facility that automatically butchers any Pal that is placed inside.

displaycharacter.name: Viewing Cage
displaycharacter.description: Container for observing captured Pals. Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production, but they do not become hungry.

electriccooler.name: Electric Cooler
electriccooler.description: A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base. Using electricity, it can really lower the temperature. Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

electricgenerator.name: Power Generator
electricgenerator.description: A power generator fueled by Electric Pals. Electric equipment won't run without this.

electricgenerator_large.name: Large Power Generator
electricgenerator_large.description: A power generator fueled by Electric Pals. Larger and with improved power generation efficiency.

electrichatchingpalegg.name: Electric Egg Incubator
electrichatchingpalegg.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. Requires electricity, but automatically keeps the inside of the incubator at appropriate temperatures.

electricheater.name: Electric Heater
electricheater.description: A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base. Using electricity, it can really heat things up. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

electrickitchen.name: Electric Kitchen
electrickitchen.description: Needed for cooking food. It requires electricity to run, but allows a large amount of meals to be prepared rapidly. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

energystorage_electric.name: Accumulator
energystorage_electric.description: A facility for storing excess electricity generated by the Power Generator.

expedition.name: Pal Expedition Station
expedition.description: A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons.  The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.

factory_hard_01.name: High-Quality Workbench
factory_hard_01.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. A small workspace limits production speeds. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

factory_hard_02.name: Production Assembly Line
factory_hard_02.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

factory_hard_03.name: Production Assembly Line II
factory_hard_03.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

factory_hard_04.name: Advanced Workshop
factory_hard_04.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed production. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

factory_money.name: Gold Coin Assembly Line
factory_money.description: An Assembly Line that manufactures Gold Coin. The work puts a strain on the mind, causing a decrease in Pal's SAN value.  Requires Pals that can work with their hands. Warning: building this facility may draw severe scrutiny from the PIDF.

farmblockv2_berries.name: Berry Plantation
farmblockv2_berries.description: A farm that can grow Red Berries. Harvest time is quick, but eating them doesn't provide much sustenance. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

farmblockv2_carrot.name: Carrot Plantation
farmblockv2_carrot.description: A farm where you can grow Carrot. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

farmblockv2_lettuce.name: Lettuce Plantation
farmblockv2_lettuce.description: A farm that can grow Lettuce. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

farmblockv2_onion.name: Onion Plantation
farmblockv2_onion.description: A farm where you can grow Onion. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

farmblockv2_potato.name: Potato Plantation
farmblockv2_potato.description: A farm where you can grow Potato. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

farmblockv2_tomato.name: Tomato Plantation
farmblockv2_tomato.description: A farm that can grow Tomato. They take time to harvest, but increase the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

farmblockv2_wheet.name: Wheat Plantation
farmblockv2_wheet.description: A farm that can grow Wheat. It requires an average amount of time to harvest. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest crops.

farm_skillfruits.name: Skillfruit Orchard
farm_skillfruits.description: A farm where Skillfruits can be cultivated. By planting the original fruit in the ground, multiple fruits of the same type can be harvested.

firecult_banner.name: Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Vertical Banner
firecult_banner.description: Decorative Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Vertical Banner.

firecult_flag.name: Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Standard
firecult_flag.description: Decorative Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Standard.

firestand.name: Ceremonial Candlestick
firestand.description: An imposing ceremonial candlestick lit by the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre and revered as sacred.  It can be placed on the ground. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

fishingpond1.name: Fishing Pond
fishingpond1.description: A ready-to-use fishing pond.  Assign a Pal to fish here at their own leisure.  Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

fishingpond2.name: Large Fishing Pond
fishingpond2.description: A ready-to-use large fishing pond.  The expanded body of water makes it possible to catch even larger Pals.  Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

flourmill.name: Mill
flourmill.description: Facility for milling Wheat to produce Flour. Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

flowerbed.name: Flower Bed
flowerbed.description: Place in base to improve gathering speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

fountain.name: Water Fountain
fountain.description: Place in base to improve watering speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

fudukue.name: Japanese Writing Table
fudukue.description: Decorative Ornamental Writing Table. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

furniturebush01_flower.description: A realistic replication of a flowering bush. For decoration only. Cannot be harvested for materials.

glass_diagonalwall.name: Glass Diagonal Wall
glass_diagonalwall.description: An angled wall built on triangular foundations for keeping out intruders. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_doorwall.name: Glass Wall and Door
glass_doorwall.description: Door built on a foundation. Becomes an entrance. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_fence.name: Glass Fence
glass_fence.description: Fence built on foundations or roofs to prevent falls.  Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_foundation.name: Glass Foundation
glass_foundation.description: A foundation for building walls or facilities on. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_pillars.name: Glass Pillar
glass_pillars.description: Column for structural support. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_pyramidroof.name: Glass Pyramid Roof
glass_pyramidroof.description: A pyramidal roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_roof.name: Glass Roof
glass_roof.description: A roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_slantedroof.description: Slanted roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_slopedroofcorner.description: A slanted triangular roof built on top of diagonal walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_slopedroofcornerreverse.description: An inverted slanted triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind.  Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_stair.description: Stairs placed below a foundation or roof for climbing up. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_trianglefoundation.description: A triangular foundation for building walls or facilities on. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_trianglestairscorner.description: A corner roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_trianglewall.description: Triangular wall built on a foundation for keeping out intruders. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_trianglewallreverse.name: Glass Triangular Wall (Inverted)
glass_trianglewallreverse.description: An inverted triangular wall built on a foundation for keeping out intruders. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_wall.name: Glass Wall
glass_wall.description: Walls built on foundations for keeping out intruders. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_wallgate.name: Glass Pal Passage Entrance
glass_wallgate.description: An entrance to a Pal passage built on a foundation. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

glass_windowwall.name: Glass Wall and Window
glass_windowwall.description: Wall with windows, built on foundations for keeping out intruders. Made of industrial-strength glass, it's quite sturdy.

globalpalstorage.name: Global Palbox
globalpalstorage.description: A facility that can store the genetic data of Pals and allows you to reconstruct them from this data.  The stored genetic data can also be transferred to other worlds.

goalsoccer_iron.name: Soccer Goal
goalsoccer_iron.description: Decorative soccer goal. Kicking a Lamball into it will get you no points.

guildchest.name: Guild Chest
guildchest.description: A chest that can instantly send and receive items through subspace.  The items inside are shared across all bases where it is placed.

hatchingpalegg.name: Egg Incubator
hatchingpalegg.description: Used for incubating a Pal Egg. If a Pal Egg is left in it, it will automatically hatch after some time has passed.

headstone.name: Tombstone
headstone.description: A gravestone that can be inscribed with text.  Use it for recording purposes.

heater.name: Heater
heater.description: A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base. It doesn't provide much warmth, but helps one to endure somewhat cold environments. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

hugekitchen.name: Large-Scale Stone Oven
hugekitchen.description: Needed for cooking food. By becoming larger, multiple Pals can cooperate to cook together. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

icecrusher.name: Cryogenic Crusher
icecrusher.description: Facility that crushes Ore and converts it into other materials. Requires a power supply and a Pal with Cooling suitability, but it's very efficient.

iron_diagonalwall.description: An angled wall built on triangular foundations for keeping out intruders. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_fence.name: Metal Fence
iron_fence.description: Fence built on foundations or roofs to prevent falls.  Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_pyramidroof.name: Metal Pyramid Roof
iron_pyramidroof.description: A pyramidal roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_slopedroofcorner.name: Metal Slanted Triangular Roof
iron_slopedroofcorner.description: A slanted triangular roof built on top of diagonal walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_slopedroofcornerreverse.name: Metal Slanted Corner Roof (Inverted)
iron_slopedroofcornerreverse.description: An inverted slanted triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind.  Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_trianglefoundation.name: Metal Triangular Foundation
iron_trianglefoundation.description: A triangular foundation for building walls or facilities on. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_triangleroof.name: Metal Triangular Roof
iron_triangleroof.description: A triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_trianglestairscorner.name: Metal Corner Roof
iron_trianglestairscorner.description: A corner roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_trianglewallreverse.name: Metal Triangular Wall (Inverted)
iron_trianglewallreverse.description: An inverted triangular wall built on a foundation for keeping out intruders.  Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

iron_wallgate.name: Metal Pal Passage Entrance
iron_wallgate.description: An entrance to a Pal passage built on a foundation. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

irori.name: Japanese Hearth
irori.description: Decorative Hearth. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

itembooth.name: Flea Market (Items)
itembooth.description: A facility for selling items. By setting products in the sales list, you can sell items to other players. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

itemchest.name: Wooden Chest
itemchest.description: Stores items. Made from wood, it breaks easily. It's probably not the best thing to store valuables in.

itemchest_02.name: Metal Chest
itemchest_02.description: Stores items. Reinforced with metal, it is somewhat durable. The increased size allows for the storage of more things.

itemchest_03.name: Refined Metal Chest
itemchest_03.description: Stores items. Made of iron, it is extremely durable. It is useful as a large, secure storage box.

itemchest_04.name: Advanced Chest
itemchest_04.description: Stores items. Quite sturdy, with plenty of storage space. It is useful as a large, secure storage box.

ivy01.name: Big Wall Ivy
ivy01.description: Decorative large ivy. Can be placed on a wall.

ivy02.name: Small Wall Ivy
ivy02.description: Decorative small ivy. Can be placed on a wall.

ivy03.name: Horizontal Wall Ivy
ivy03.description: Decorative horizontal ivy. Can be placed on a wall.

japanesestyle_diagonalwall.description: An angled wall built on triangular foundations for keeping out intruders. You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

japanesestyle_doorwall_01.description: Door built on a foundation. Becomes an entrance. You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

japanesestyle_doorwall_02.name: Japanese-Style Door B

japanesestyle_doorwall_03.name: Japanese-Style Door C

japanesestyle_pillar.name: Japanese-Style Pillar

japanesestyle_pyramidroof.name: Japanese-Style Pyramid Roof
japanesestyle_pyramidroof.description: A pyramidal roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

japanesestyle_roof_01.name: Japanese-Style Roof A
japanesestyle_roof_01.description: A roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. The top is covered with tatami mats. You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

japanesestyle_roof_02.name: Japanese-Style Roof B
japanesestyle_roof_02.description: A roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. The top is covered with tiles. You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

japanesestyle_stair.name: Japanese-Style Stairs

japanesestyle_triangleroof_01.description: A triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind.  The top is covered with tatami mats. You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

japanesestyle_triangleroof_02.name: Japanese-Style Triangular Roof B
japanesestyle_triangleroof_02.description: A triangular roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind.  The top is covered with tiles.  You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

japanesestyle_trianglestairscorner_01.name: Japanese-Style Corner Roof
japanesestyle_trianglestairscorner_01.description: A corner roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

japanesestyle_trianglewall.name: Japanese-Style Triangular Wall
japanesestyle_trianglewall.description: Triangular wall built on a foundation for keeping out intruders. You can create stylish Japanese-style architecture.

kakejiku.description: Decorative hanging scroll. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

koro.name: Incense Burner
koro.description: Decorative Incense Burner. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

lab.name: Pal Labor Research Lab
lab.description: A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals.  By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.

lamp.name: Lamp
lamp.description: A light source that provides illumination to a base even at night. Requires electricity, but lights up a larger area.

largeceilinglamp.name: Large Ceiling Lamp
largeceilinglamp.description: A light source that provides illumination to a base even at night. It can be placed on a ceiling. Requires a significant amount of electricity, but lights up an even larger area.

largelamp.name: Large Mounted Lamp
largelamp.description: A light source that provides illumination to a base even at night. Requires a significant amount of electricity, but lights up an even larger area.

light_candlesticks_top.name: Chandelier
light_candlesticks_top.description: Chandelier that provides illumination. Requires electricity to light.

light_candlesticks_wall.name: Wall Lamp
light_candlesticks_wall.description: Wall lamp that provides illumination. Requires electricity to light.

light_fireplace01.name: Brick Fireplace
light_fireplace01.description: Brick fireplace that provides illumination. Must be lit with fire from a Fire Pal.

light_fireplace02.name: Fireplace
light_fireplace02.description: Fireplace that provides illumination. Must be lit with fire from a Fire Pal.

light_floorlamp01.name: Antique Brown Floor Lamp
light_floorlamp01.description: Antique brown floor lamp that provides illumination. Requires electricity to light.

light_floorlamp02.name: Antique Red Floor Lamp
light_floorlamp02.description: Antique red floor lamp that provides illumination. Requires electricity to light.

light_lightpole01.name: Simple Street Lamp
light_lightpole01.description: Simple street lamp that provides illumination. Requires electricity to light.

light_lightpole02.name: Double Street Lamp
light_lightpole02.description: Double street lamp that provides illumination. Requires electricity to light.

light_lightpole03.name: Retro Street Lamp
light_lightpole03.description: Retro street lamp that provides illumination. Requires electricity to light.

light_lightpole04.name: Stylish Street Lamp
light_lightpole04.description: Stylish street lamp that provides illumination. Requires electricity to light.

machinegame01_iron.name: Claw Machine
machinegame01_iron.description: Decorative claw crane. Broken, it can't be played.

machinevending01_iron.name: Cola Vending Machine
machinevending01_iron.description: Decorative cola vending machine. Cannot be used to buy items.

manualelectricgenerator.name: Human-Powered Generator
manualelectricgenerator.description: A facility that converts rotational motion into electrical energy. The efficiency is low, and the Pals working here will experience a decrease in SAN value, but they will gain experience points.

medicalpalbed_02.name: Straw Pal Bed
medicalpalbed_02.description: A straw bed for Pals. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. It isn't soft, but it's better than nothing.

medicalpalbed_03.name: Fluffy Pal Bed
medicalpalbed_03.description: A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. Pals love sleeping on fluffy beds like this.

medicalpalbed_04.name: Large Pal Bed
medicalpalbed_04.description: A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. Even large Pals can sleep soundly on a bed like this.

medicalpalbed_05.name: Pal Pod
medicalpalbed_05.description: A healing pod for Pals. Used when Pals are injured or to rest at night. Thanks to technological advancements, the healing amount has increased.

medicinefacility_01.name: Medieval Medicine Workbench
medicinefacility_01.description: A facility for making Pal medicine. It can only produce simple medicines. Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.

medicinefacility_02.name: Electric Medicine Workbench
medicinefacility_02.description: A facility for making Pal medicine. It requires electricity, but can produce high quality medicine. Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.

medicinefacility_03.name: Advanced Medicine Workbench
medicinefacility_03.description: A facility for making medicine to cure Pals' illnesses.  With advanced technology, it can also create unknown medicines.  Assign the task to a Pal capable of pharmacy work.

metal_doorwall.name: Metal Door
metal_doorwall.description: Door built on a foundation. Becomes an entrance. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

metal_foundation.name: Metal Foundation
metal_foundation.description: A foundation for building walls or facilities on. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

metal_gate.name: Iron Gate
metal_gate.description: Gate large enough for big Pals to pass through. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

metal_pillars.name: Metal Pillar
metal_pillars.description: Column for structural support. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

metal_roof.description: A roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

metal_slantedroof.description: Slanted roof built on top of walls to keep out the rain and wind. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

metal_wall.name: Metal Wall
metal_wall.description: Walls built on foundations for keeping out intruders. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

metal_windowwall.name: Metal Wall and Window
metal_windowwall.description: Wall built on a foundation for keeping out intruders. Includes a window. Made from metal, it is extremely durable.

miningtool.name: Mining Cart
miningtool.description: Place in base to improve mining speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

mirror01_wall_stone.name: Antique Wall Mirror
mirror01_wall_stone.description: Decorative antique wall mirror. Can be placed on walls.

monsterfarm.name: Ranch
monsterfarm.description: Farm for raising sheep and fowl-like Pals. Assign a Pal with the appropriate Partner Skill to a farm to produce items.

multielectrichatchingpalegg.name: Large-Scale Electric Egg Incubator
multielectrichatchingpalegg.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. While power supply is required, it allows multiple eggs to be incubated simultaneously at the optimal temperature.

multielectrichatchingpaleggwithbreed.name: Ancient Hatchery
multielectrichatchingpaleggwithbreed.description: An advanced breeding facility of ancient civilization technology, enclosed in electronic glass. It fully automates everything from egg production to incubation at high speed, and increases the inheritance rate of rare skills. Pals are managed through holograms, it requires minimal pasture space.

multihatchingpalegg.name: Large Incubator
multihatchingpalegg.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs.  It automatically maintains a suitable temperature and can hatch multiple eggs at once.

oilpump.name: Crude Oil Extractor
oilpump.description: Equipment required to extract Crude Oil from oil fields. Requires a power supply to operate.

oilpump02.name: High-Pressure Crude Oil Extractor
oilpump02.description: A device that pumps and extracts Crude Oil from deep underground. It can produce Crude Oil even in areas without oil fields, but it can only be placed on open ground with no structures beneath it. It requires a far greater supply of electricity than the Crude Oil Extractor.

olympiccauldron.name: Flame Cauldron
olympiccauldron.description: Place in base to improve fire-making speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

operatingtable.name: Pal Surgery Table
operatingtable.description: A facility where surgery can be performed on Pals to change their gender or passive skills.

palbooth.name: Flea Market (Pals)
palbooth.description: A facility for selling Pals. By setting Pals in the sales list, you can sell them to other players. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

palboxv2.name: Palbox
palboxv2.description: Facility for storing captured Pals. Pals inside gradually recover Health. Area around this facility becomes a base.

palfoodbox.name: Feed Box
palfoodbox.description: A box for storing Pal food. Pals can feed from it when hungry. Make sure to keep it well-stocked to keep your Pals happy.

palmedicinebox.name: Medicine Rack
palmedicinebox.description: A shelf for storing medicine. Sick Pals will come here to take their medicine. Be sure to keep the medicine stocked.

piano01_stone.name: Grand Piano
piano01_stone.description: Decorative grand piano. Cannot be played.

piano02_stone.name: Upright Piano
piano02_stone.description: Decorative upright piano. Cannot be played.

playerbed_02.name: Shoddy Bed
playerbed_02.description: A shoddy bed for humans. Use it when injured or to sleep at night. You won't be able to sleep soundly without a roof over your head.

playerbed_03.name: Fine Bed
playerbed_03.description: A fluffy bed for humans. Use it when injured or to sleep at night. You won't be able to sleep soundly without a roof over your head.

quartzpit.name: Pure Quartz Quarry
quartzpit.description: A facility for producing Pure Pure Quartz.  Mining Quartz is grueling physical work. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

refrigerator.name: Refrigerator
refrigerator.description: Large food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

repairbench.name: Repair Bench
repairbench.description: Workbench for repairing broken tools. Materials are needed to make repairs.

sanitydecrease1.name: Alpha Wave Generator
sanitydecrease1.description: A device that emits alpha waves to help Pals relax. Slows the rate at which the SAN value of Base Pals decreases. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

scientist_banner.name: PAL Genetic Research Unit Vertical Banner
scientist_banner.description: Decorative PAL Genetic Research Unit Vertical Banner.

scientist_flag.name: PAL Genetic Research Unit Standard
scientist_flag.description: Decorative PAL Genetic Research Unit Standard.

seika.name: Flower Arrangement
seika.description: Decorative Flower Arrangement. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

shelf01_wall_stone.description: Antique cabinet for storing items. Can be placed on walls.

shelf02_iron.description: Long iron shelf for storing items.

shelf03_iron.description: Orange locker for storing items. Decorated with Pal stickers.

shelf03_stone.name: Antique Chest
shelf03_stone.description: Antique chest for storing items. Adorned with a photo of a Pal.

shelf04_stone.description: Antique side chest for storing items. Adorned with a photo of a Pal.

signexit_ceiling_iron.description: Decorative emergency exit sign. Can be placed on ceilings.

signexit_wall_iron.name: Emergency Exit Wall Sign
signexit_wall_iron.description: Decorative emergency exit sign. Can be placed on walls.

silo.name: Silo
silo.description: Place in base to improve planting speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

skinchange.name: Pal Dressing Facility
skinchange.description: Pal Dressing Facility. Give your Pals a new look! Skins obtained inside and outside the game can be applied here!

skyislandorepit.name: Soralite Quarry
skyislandorepit.description: Facility for producing Soralite. Digging Soralite is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

snowman.name: Snowman
snowman.description: Place in base to improve cooling speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

spa.name: Hot Spring
spa.description: Facility where Pals on base can rest. Restores SAN after a long day of hard work.

spa2.name: High Quality Hot Spring
spa2.description: Facility where Pals on base can rest. Now comfier and restores more SAN.

spa3.name: Japanese-Style Hot Spring
spa3.description: Facility where Pals on base can rest.  Its calming, traditional Japanese design offers an extra boost to SAN recovery.

spherefactory_black_01.name: Sphere Workbench
spherefactory_black_01.description: A Primitive Workbench for producing spheres used for capturing Pals. A small workspace keeps the production speed slow. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

spherefactory_black_02.name: Sphere Assembly Line
spherefactory_black_02.description: An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals. By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

spherefactory_black_03.name: Sphere Assembly Line II
spherefactory_black_03.description: An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals. Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

spherefactory_black_04.name: Advanced Sphere Assembly Line
spherefactory_black_04.description: An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals. Advanced machinery has been introduced, allowing for the production of spheres at high speed. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

stationdeforest2.name: Logging Site
stationdeforest2.description: A facility for producing Wood. Cutting wood is hard work that requires much physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled in logging.

stationdeforest3.name: Logging Site II
stationdeforest3.description: Facility for producing Hardwood.  Cutting wood is hard work that requires much physical endurance.  Leave it to Pals skilled in logging.

stonepit.name: Stone Pit
stonepit.description: A facility for producing Stone. Mining Stone is hard work that requires much physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

stone_diagonalwall.name: Stone Diagonal Wall
stone_diagonalwall.description: An angled wall built on triangular foundations for keeping out intruders. Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

stone_doorwall.name: Stone Door
stone_doorwall.description: Door built on a foundation. Becomes an entrance. Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

stone_fence.name: Stone Fence
stone_fence.description: Fence built on foundations or roofs to prevent falls.  Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

stone_foundation.description: A foundation for building walls or facilities on. Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

stone_gate.name: Stone Gate
stone_gate.description: Gate large enough for big Pals to pass through. Made from stone, it is reasonably sturdy.

stone_pillar.name: Stone Pillar

sulfurpit.name: Sulfur Quarry
sulfurpit.description: Facility for producing Sulfur. Digging Sulfur is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

tansu.name: Japanese-Style Chest
tansu.description: Stores items. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

television01_iron.name: Old TV
television01_iron.description: Decorative old TV. Left behind by an ancient civilization. Now it only shows images of Pengullet.

toilet01_stone.name: Antique Toilet
toilet01_stone.description: Decorative antique toilet. Cannot be used for its original purpose.

toolboxv1.name: Large Toolbox
toolboxv1.description: Place in base to improve handiwork speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

torch.name: Mounted Torch
torch.description: A light source that provides illumination to a base even at night. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

toro.name: Stone Lantern
toro.description: Decorative Stone Lantern. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

trafficsign01_iron.name: No Pals Beyond Sign
trafficsign01_iron.description: Decorative No Pals Beyond sign. Used in ancient times, it now serves no real purpose.

trafficsign02_iron.name: Stop Sign
trafficsign02_iron.description: Decorative Stop sign. Used in ancient times, it now serves no real purpose.

trafficsign03_iron.name: Beware of Eikthyrdeer Sign
trafficsign03_iron.description: Decorative Beware of Eikthyrdeer sign. In ancient times, collisions between Eikthyrdeer and other Pals were frequent.

trafficsign04_iron.name: Beware of Mammorest Sign
trafficsign04_iron.description: Decorative Beware of Mammorest sign. In ancient times, those who angered a Mammorest were often killed.

transmissiontower.name: Electric Pylon
transmissiontower.description: Place in base to improve electricity generating speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

trap_leghold.name: Bear Trap (Small)
trap_leghold.description: Trap that immobilizes Pals who step on it. The capture rate with the sphere increases when a Pal is trapped. Only effective on small Pals.

trap_leghold_big.name: Bear Trap (Large)
trap_leghold_big.description: A bear trap to immobilize large Pals. The capture rate with the sphere increases when a Pal is trapped. Only effective on large Pals, small Pals will not be caught.

trap_mineattack.name: Mine
trap_mineattack.description: Trap that explodes when a Pal steps on it. It deals damage to a wide area.

trap_mineelecshock.name: Electric Mine
trap_mineelecshock.description: Trap that electrocutes the Pal that steps on it. The electrocuted Pal has a higher capture rate with the sphere.

trap_minefreeze.name: Ice Mine
trap_minefreeze.description: Trap that freezes the Pal that steps on it. The frozen Pal has a higher capture rate with the sphere.

trap_noose.name: Hanging Trap
trap_noose.description: Trap that catches Pals passing through it. Pals caught in the trap are easier to catch with Spheres. Only effective on small Pals.

wallsignboard.name: Wall-Mounted Sign
wallsignboard.description: A signboard to write on. Can be hung on walls.

walltorch.name: Wall Torch
walltorch.description: A light source that provides illumination to a base even at night. It can be placed on walls. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

walltorch02.name: Majestic Wall Torch
walltorch02.description: An imposing torch lit by the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre and revered as sacred.  It can be placed on walls. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

weaponfactory_dirty_01.name: Weapon Workbench
weaponfactory_dirty_01.description: A Primitive Workbench for producing weapons and ammunition. A small workspace prevents the production of high quality weapons. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

weaponfactory_dirty_02.name: Weapon Assembly Line
weaponfactory_dirty_02.description: An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition. By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

weaponfactory_dirty_03.name: Weapon Assembly Line II
weaponfactory_dirty_03.description: An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition. Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

weaponfactory_dirty_04.name: Advanced Weapon Assembly Line
weaponfactory_dirty_04.description: An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition. Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed weapon production. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.
